_about: Copy to presets.json (git-ignored), edit, then run `npm run presets:upload`. Fields: company, track (enablement | content | ai), emphasize (skills from src/content/config.ts), pin (optional case study slugs to force to the top), greeting (optional; {company} is filled in), status (optional: archived keeps old links working without the company name), note (private, never shown).

example-co-help.greeting: Hi, {company} team! Want to see how Taylor turns support cases into content people actually find?
